pages.text:
Frank spots his big mug on
the sink.

Frank grabs the mug. He gets
a cold drink from a jug.
Glug! Glug! Glug!

A plump bug is in the drink.
Can you spot the bug in the
mug?

Frank can not spot the plump
bug in the mug.

Frank swigs the drink from
the big mug.

Can you still spot the plump
bug in the mug?

No! The bug is not in the
mug.
The plump bug is in Frank!
